question: RTX 4090 FP8 LLM inference throughput benchmark

sources.title: RTX 4090 AI Performance Analysis and Computational Throughput Limits
sources.snippet: The NVIDIA RTX 4090 is a powerhouse for AI, delivering up to 660 TOPS in FP8/INT8 and 1321 TOPS in INT4. Its 24GB of high-speed VRAM and the architectural advantages of the Ada Lovelace L2 cache make it the definitive choice for local LLM inference, image generation, and model fine-tuning.

sources.snippet: RTX 4090 LLM benchmarks for local inference, testing LLMs from 8B to 32B across 4K - 131K context. Includes prompt processing and token generation performance.

sources.title: RTX 4090 AI TOPS Performance Guide - insights.terabox.com
sources.snippet: As of 2026, the NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 is officially rated at 1,321.22 AI TOPS for INT8 and FP8 data formats. When utilizing extreme INT4 quantization, this figure scales to a peak of 2,642.42 TOPS. For real-world Large Language Model (LLM) inference, users can expect between 80 and 120 tokens per second on 8B parameter models like Llama 3.3.
